fullPassage: From around 3000 BC, the Sumerian officials would mark their lists of goods on clay tablets. If they wanted to record five fish, they would mark five pictures of a fish. Their first great intellectual leap came from __________. In other words, they would represent five fish with a numeral for the number five alongside a symbol for the fish. If they wanted to describe five of something else, they realized they could keep the same numeral and trade the object symbol for a cow, or a jar of oil, or whatever else they were interested in. The Sumerians had developed the idea of an emancipated number, existing in its own right and independent of whatever it is being used to count. It is easy to take the emancipated number for granted as it is so deeply set into modern thought, but to the earliest civilizations it was intellectually new and extremely powerful.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ setting → set: "is deeply set into"에서 set은 과거분사로 수동태(자리잡힌 상태). setting(현재분사)은 부적절.

❌ ④ old(오래된): 원문은 new(새로운) → 반의어

✅ ② existing(존재하는): 원문 일치
✅ ③ granted(당연한 것으로): 원문 일치

det.korean: "In other words"가 빈칸을 구체화하고, 숫자와 기호의 분리가 핵심이므로 수량 개념과 세는 대상을 분리하는 것이 정답.

questions.passage: From around 3000 BC, the Sumerian officials would mark their lists of goods on clay tablets. If they wanted to record five fish, they would mark five pictures of a fish. Their first great intellectual leap came from __________. In other words, they would represent five fish with a numeral for the number five alongside a symbol for the fish. If they wanted to describe five of something else, they realized they could keep the same numeral and trade the object symbol for a cow, or a jar of oil, or whatever else they were interested in. The Sumerians had developed the idea of an emancipated number, existing in its own right and independent of whatever it is being used to count. It is easy to take the emancipated number for granted as it is so deeply set into modern thought, but to the earliest civilizations it was intellectually new and extremely powerful.

det.tip: 핵심 혁신: numeral(숫자) 유지 + symbol(기호) 교환 → 다양한 대상 기록 가능

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

❌ ④ 현대인은 고대 수학을 과소평가한다: 과소평가가 아닌 당연시

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 추론할 수 있는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 숫자를 분리하기 전에는 물고기 그림을 수만큼 반복해야 했으므로, 대량의 물품을 기록하기 비효율적이었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 숫자 분리 전에는 대량의 물품을 기록하기 비효율적이었다: 물고기 5마리 = 그림 5개 → 100마리면 100개 필요
❌ ① 수메르인은 물고기만 기록했다: cow, oil 등도 언급

det.tip: 추론: 그림 반복 방식 → 수량이 많으면 비효율 → 분리가 혁신적이었던 이유

ch: 수메르인들은 물고기 외에 다른 물품을 기록하지 않았다.
